name: viper-charts-js
description: Charting library for plotting financial data including lines, candlesticks, moving averages, and more.

paragraphs: ViperCharts is a free and open-source cross-market charting platform for plotting financial data including lines, candlesticks, moving averages, and more. It provides a flexible and extensible framework for creating interactive charts with support for multiple data sources, timeframes, and visualization types.
NOTE: This is still an early Beta build of the package. The API is subject to changes in the future. Please use for experimental purposes.
features: Line Charts: Plot single value data as lines
Candlestick Charts: Display OHLC data as candlesticks
Volume Charts: Show volume data as bars
Volume by Side: Display buy/sell volume separately
Footprint Charts: Show order flow and executed volume at price levels
